name: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd
summary: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells organic silicon methylsilane and phenyl products. It offers hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisiloxane, iodotrimethylsilane, dimethyldiethoxylsilane, trimethylchlorosilane, sodium hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisilane, hexamethyldisilylurea, dimethyldimethoxysilane, trimethylethoxysilane, and hexamethyldisilylurea products. The company also provides phenyltrimethoxysilane, phenyltriethoxysilane, diphenyldimethoxysilane, diphenyldiethoxysilane, octaphenylcyclotetrasiloxane, and diphenyldihydroxysilane; and phenyl silicone rubber, phenyl silicone resin, and phenyl silicone oil.
